protocol.train_graph: structural scores use only train-split edges
protocol.positives: validation/test positives come from their own split
protocol.negatives: equal number per positive, sampled from directed non-edges while matching the positive source-pair distribution
protocol.negative_exclusion: all observed directed edges are excluded
protocol.per_source_metrics: reported for validation and test; threshold is selected on pooled validation and reused for every source
protocol.threshold: selected on validation by maximum F1 among non-trivial thresholds, then applied once to test
protocol.threshold_note: the trivial all-positive threshold is excluded when a higher threshold exists
protocol.common_neighbors_graph: train edges treated as undirected for common-neighbor counting
protocol.not_a_risk_model: link prediction is not disruption-risk prediction

selection_criterion: highest validation average precision, then validation ROC-AUC

threshold_selection.criterion: maximum F1 among thresholds that predict at least one negative
